name: unchecked-error
description: A write error is swallowed, so a failed commit reports success. The hunk header's new-side start matches where its first context line sits in content: a model anchors off the header, so a fabricated one scores a correct finding as a miss.

expected.why: tx.Commit's error is discarded, so a failed commit is reported to the caller as success and the claim silently does not exist.
